what: First-divergence logit forensics on the gfx1100 greedy nondeterminism (vllm#50603), Muse/512/TP=1/eager reproducer on vLLM 0.25.1

cell.protocol: warmup x1 (max_tokens=8, uninstrumented) then 8 measured greedy generations (max_tokens=64, temperature=0.0, ignore_eos=True)

first_divergence_findings.stage_B_equality: argmax-input fp32 logits differ at every first-divergence position (28/28 pairs), max abs diff 2.1-3.3 logit units, identical token histories through D-1
first_divergence_findings.reference_variation: max cross-run |logit diff| at 35 aligned identical-history positions: 8.8125 (median 3.25)
first_divergence_findings.offline_argmax: deterministic (CPU x20, GPU x20) and matches vLLM selection for 28/28 pairs
first_divergence_findings.sampler_verdict: NOT the origin: argmax consistent with its input at all 512 instrumented steps

classification: B (forward/logits divergence with healthy margins) — divergence materially present upstream of sampling; margins are NOT near-tie-sized relative to measured cross-run variation

phase9_hidden_state_boundary.method: gated sitecustomize hook wrapping LogitsProcessor._get_logits; hidden=logits hashes per decode step
phase9_hidden_state_boundary.result: 8 distinct final-hidden-state hashes at EVERY step (incl. step 0) across the 8 generations; prefix-cache hit for all measured generations proven by call counting (520 = 8 warmup + 8x64, zero prefill calls)
phase9_hidden_state_boundary.verdict: divergence originates in the decoder forward pass, upstream of the LM head and the final hidden state; identical inputs at aligned steps

phase10_w4a16_microprobe.op: torch.ops._rocm_C.gptq_gemm_rdna3 via RDNA3W4A16LinearKernel, REAL layer-0 q_proj weights (K=6656, N=4096, group 128), fixed seeded bf16 input
phase10_w4a16_microprobe.verdict: the isolated W4A16 GEMM is NOT bit-repeatable on fixed inputs; variation is maximal at the decode batch shape M=1 and near-absent at M=128
